claim_boundary: Offline counterfactual component benchmark on perturbations derived from the five normal training demonstrations; not an independent test set and not an end-to-end simulator success-rate evaluation. V3 admits break-link trials only inside a formal LINK origin interval, excludes LINK_PENDING and isolated per-state linked evidence, and restores the original eight-state perturbation plus four-state aftermath window after event-consistent relation propagation makes valid intervals available; no failure-set metric is used for parameter selection.
